data.title: Hall Gad Architects
data.subtitle: A force for local good.
data.text: WITH a strong sense of social responsibility for the physical spaces in which their structures inhabit, Hall Gad Architects are a new practice who specialize in ambitious and challenging architecture that aims to enhance and sustain environments and ecosystems alike. We worked with founders Jessica Hall and Holden Gad to create an identity and digital presence that matched their aesthetic sensibilities and sheer sense of scale and perspective.

data.title: AURA
data.subtitle: Naturally sourced products for mind, body and soul.
data.text: AURA are a newly-founded beauty company that are as invested in mental health as much as physical, choosing to donate 10% of their profits to mental health charities across America from their pop-up stores. It’s been our pleasure to work with them on their ident and launch rollout, handling everything from sun-care packaging to social campaigns, with a comprehensive e-commerce website spearheading a digital phase coming later in the year.

data.title: The Hall
data.subtitle: The low-cost theatre at the heart of the community.
data.text: FROM big stage staples to independent small-run plays, The Hall Theatre aims to provide an affordable, community-driven way to enjoy this wonderful art-form. In the face of difficult funding conditions, it's more important than ever to find unique ways in which to thrive, and so we're honored to be partnering with them on their visual direction across both physical and digital spaces.

data.title: INNERSTATE
data.subtitle: Full scholarship sport representation.
data.text: INNERSTATE are a talent agency that represents a diverse range of exceptional athletes, musicians, and stage actors all over the globe, offering support and opportunity through close collaboration and over 20 years of hands-on experience though its full scholarship program, which gives vital mentorship to young talent as they navigate the early stages of their careers. We worked with them to craft a bold, energetic brand direction to match their infectious personalities.
